reply: 094 in the exponential term. The third term's fitted constants are unreliable, so this is only a close approximation. The one-parameter variants I tried (for example t^p alone, or t·exp(-t)) gave NMSEs around 1e-5 or worse. The third term seems to depend on t but not on A in any simple way I tested.

def equation(t, A, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(t) + params[1]*np.exp(-params[2]*t)*A**3 + params[3]*t**params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*t)
